commands_used: answer 1. I work for Nesh-Deeka as Toh-Wo, a Secret-Speaker. The order hunts the Eye of Argonia, the old kings jewel that can heal sick Hist, at the Root under the sea. The Collector (Ennodius Vanin) has hired men camped at the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle, digging in a cave. 2. Find out what they found in the Grey Tooth Cave, via the door to the cave on the north face. 3. Fight the three hirelings, or slip past them; also examine Vanin Rubbing. 4. I do not understand what the Root and Eye truly are beyond the journal, who the Collector is, or the Unbound. I could ask the hirelings or read the rubbing.

answer 1. The cave niche is empty; a sailor scratched that the stone went to the Stormwidow by her captain order in year 181. The Collector E.V. has sold the ship name to diggers and will buy what they find. 2. Go to the Wreck of the Stormwidow on the south-west beach and search the hold, the ballast crate, for the kings stone. 3. Fight whoever is at the wreck or slip past them. 4. I do not know what the kings stone is or what it does, who the diggers are, or what the Collector wants it for. I could find out at the wreck.

answer 1. I took the Kings Marker Stone from the Stormwidow ballast crate; it shows seven towers in water, one cut deeper. Unbound scouts were searching for it too; their recipe for the seal lies nearby. 2. Speak to the wounded scout Tah-Leesh on the sand below the bow. 3. Talk to her, fight the scouts, or take the recipe and seal; sell or keep the stone, or give it to the Collector or my order. 4. I do not know which tower is the deeper one, what the stone opens, or why the Unbound seal trees. Tah-Leesh may tell me.

answer 1. I hold the Kings Marker Stone. Tah-Leesh of the Unbound said her leader Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells servants of the Toh-Reel-Ka (my order) to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, the Archwardens fort on the Chixathe Mesa. 2. Bring the stone to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Deliver it as told, or sell it or give it to the Collector, or fight the Unbound; I can also ask about Fort Chalkmoth. 4. I do not understand what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, why Cuts-the-Old-Knot says it, or what the deeper tower means. I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or visit the fort.

answer 1. I gave the stone to Never-Writes-Twice and got 100 gold. The stone marks one of seven drowned spires off Lilmoth on the sea floor of Benthic Yobesh, a step toward the Root and the Eye of Argonia. 2. Go by boat from Lilmoth to Bell Station to ask the divers which tower; or visit Fort Chalkmoth on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara first. 3. Either order. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed the cellar moaning as wind. 4. I do not know what moans in the Chixathe cellar, why the Unbound seal trees, or who the Collector Vanin really is. I could learn by visiting.

answer I am Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, reporting to Never-Writes-Twice. At the Grey Tooth cave the niche was empty; the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) rubbing sent me to the wreck of the Stormwidow, where I took the Kings Marker Stone (seven drowned towers, one cut deeper) from the ballast crate ahead of Unbound scouts. The wounded Unbound scout Tah-Leesh said her leader Cuts-the-Old-Knot tells the order to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth (Archwarden fort, Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara). I delivered the stone and was paid 100 gold (about 1050 total). Never-Writes-Twice says the towers are the drowned spires off Lilmoth in Benthic Yobesh; the divers of Bell Station, an islet east of Lilmoth, reached by boat from Lilmoth, will know which tower. I still carry the rapier, lockpicks, 3 Grey Seals, Pale Harvest key, disc, keystone, eye-setting. Unknown: what the Root and Eye are exactly, why the Unbound seal trees, what moans at Fort Chalkmoth, and what the Collector wants. Next: Bell Station, or Fort Chalkmoth first.
